linkedin:
Connecting an AI agent to a browser usually means handing it a window and hoping for the best. In S3 Browser the agent gets real tools instead.

A connected Claude Code or Codex agent can:
· Save a page to Memory
· Extract data from a page
· Gather tabs into a space
· Use reader view and translation
· Take timestamped video notes
· Add to the research board
· Use the built-in developer and QA tools

It asks once per site before running page code, and reading a site's storage stays read-only with your approval, every time.

Free for Macs with Apple silicon.
https://s3dat.com/products/s3-browser
